deliverables.readme:
# CycleTwin_VIT

**Team: CycleTwin**  
**College: VIT**  
Team leader: Kushagra Gupta. Registration and contact details are submitted by the human leader on Unstop.

> Synthetic research prototype. Not for diagnosis, contraception or conception planning. No clinical validity, hormone inference or real-world accuracy is claimed.

## Problem and use case

CycleTwin studies whether calendar and wearable-style signals can flag a generated cycle with ovulation after day 21 or no generated ovulation. It does not diagnose PMOS. The current population mixes synthetic PMOS and non-PMOS archetypes.

## What is built

- One persisted fitted prediction path for the benchmark, cohort, patient and Kushi views. src/inference.py returns the probability, validation threshold, fallback and exact additive feature evidence.
- Static EHR-lite and dynamic observations share a feature builder. EHR-lite is **oracle-adjacent, simulator-internal evidence**, because it includes a label-generating latent. No actual hormone assay is used.
- Explicit safety inputs fail closed. An abstaining view suppresses personal scores, intervals, explanations, sandbox outputs and alerts.
- Ovulation day uses a separate calendar/temperature heuristic. Its interval is conditional on an ovulatory cycle and remains an illustration without measured frozen coverage.
- A separate reproductive/metabolic simulator illustrates assumed dynamics. It does not affect the fitted score. The input-editing sandbox does not estimate causal treatment effects.
- Apple Health-shaped XML parsing is implemented. Imported XML does not become a scored patient. Upload temporary files are deleted after parsing.
- Meet Kushi is a fictional story selected by generator truth and declared seeds, never model output. Later scenario seeds are independent replays, not real longitudinal measurements.

## Run

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
streamlit run app.py
```

The selected fitted model artifacts are included. `make all` regenerates synthetic development evaluation, models, claims, README tables and figures. `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` runs the suite, including AppTest.

## Stack and pinned dependencies

Python, NumPy, scikit-learn, pandas, Streamlit and Altair. The classifier uses median imputation, standardization, logistic regression and validation Platt calibration. Richer tiers fall back to calendar when validation does not support Brier improvement. Validation F1 selects operating thresholds.

- numpy==2.0.2
- pandas==2.3.3
- streamlit==1.50.0
- altair==5.5.0
- scikit-learn==1.6.1
- scipy==1.13.1
- joblib==1.5.3
- threadpoolctl==3.7.0

## Synthetic development results

All values in this document are generated from docs/claims.json by scripts/build_claims.py. These seeds are development evidence because earlier versions repeatedly evaluated them. They are not an untouched final test. Patient-level splits within each run prevent patient-ID overlap.

The predeclared temperature tier at day 18 has mean synthetic AUROC 0.905584 and Brier 0.119091. The same snapshot contains 3,240 test cycles across the development seeds. These are descriptive seed means, not pooled AUROC or clinical accuracy.

- [Complete implementation audit](docs/audit_2026-10-20/CycleTwin_full_audit.md), a historical snapshot before the corrections.
- [After-audit change log](docs/CHANGELOG_AFTER_AUDIT.md) and [generated claims](docs/claims.json).
- [Evaluation plan](docs/eval_plan.md), [assumptions](docs/assumptions.md), [jury Q&A](docs/jury_qa.md).
- Synthetic labels and signals share assumptions. No clinical, external or prospective real-person validation exists.
- Old generator start dates can overlap; logged-start error is not fully propagated through real-time feature alignment.
- No validated treatment model, hormone inference, contraception guidance or conception-planning support exists.
- Frozen evaluation is complete. Robustness, ops measurements and a Bayesian state estimator remain separate follow-up gates until their evidence is generated.

## Deliverables

- [Architecture PDF](deliverables/CycleTwin_architecture.pdf) and [editable PPTX](deliverables/CycleTwin_architecture.pptx).
- [Pitch PDF](deliverables/CycleTwin_pitch_deck.pdf) and [editable PPTX](deliverables/CycleTwin_pitch_deck.pptx).
- [Submission checklist](SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.md).
- Required video: human recording/upload deferred by the user. **No video link exists yet.** Scripts are in docs/video_script_20min.md and docs/video_script_3min.md. The competition requires a minimum 20-minute recording.

Existing screenshots are historical UI captures and do not represent a new visual-verification claim.

## Licence and disclosure

Code uses the [MIT License](LICENSE). All project datasets are synthetic. Published medical references provide context and are not training data. AI coding assistants helped build this project. No LLM runs in the prediction or explanation path.

# CycleTwin 20-minute script

Synthetic research prototype. Not for diagnosis, contraception or conception planning.

Human recording deferred. All project numbers below come from docs/claims.json.

## CycleTwin
Cycle-by-cycle late or absent ovulation research
Team CycleTwin / VIT
A fitted synthetic forecasting workflow with explicit safety gates
Meet Kushi: fictional persona, never performance evidence

## The research problem
Monitoring irregular cycles without claiming a PMOS diagnosis
Target: generated ovulation after the configured cutoff, or generated absence
India context: 7.2% by NIH criteria and 19.6% by Rotterdam criteria
Published prevalence depends on definition. It is not the simulator mixture or model accuracy.

## Meet Kushi
Fictional synthetic persona - not a real patient - not performance evidence.
21 years, year 3 B.Tech
Hostel life, exam-season sleep debt, mother with type 2 diabetes, smartwatch wearer.
Actual generated past lengths: 41, 38, 41, 38, 44, 51 days
Selection uses generator truth and a declared seed, never predicted risk

## Static and dynamic input streams
EHR-lite is implemented and explicitly oracle-adjacent
Static: generated IR latent, androgen, age, BMI and family history
Dynamic: calendar history, RHR, HRV, steps, sleep and temperature
No measured hormone values. The XML parser demonstrates input shape only.

## One fitted prediction path
The dashboard loads the same persisted pipeline used by the benchmark


## Training and selection
Every explicit operating choice uses train or validation data
Patient counts per development seed: train 840, validation 180, test 180
Training medians and scaling, logistic regression, validation Platt calibration
Validation Brier-gain rule selects richer features or calendar fallback
Validation F1 chooses the threshold. Test outcomes never choose that threshold.

## Synthetic development evidence: day 10
Seed means describe the current generator, not clinical forecasting


## Synthetic development evidence: day 14
Seed means describe the current generator, not clinical forecasting


## Synthetic development evidence: day 18
Seed means describe the current generator, not clinical forecasting


## Frozen synthetic evidence: day 10
Reserved seeds, unchanged train/validation choices, one guarded run


## Frozen synthetic evidence: day 14
Reserved seeds, unchanged train/validation choices, one guarded run


## Frozen synthetic evidence: day 18
Reserved seeds, unchanged train/validation choices, one guarded run


## Evidence at the latest sensor snapshot
Predeclared temperature sensor tier, descriptive seed means
Synthetic day 18, Tier 2: AUROC 0.907, Brier 0.117
3,240 synthetic test cycles across 3 frozen seeds
A separate frozen evaluation artifact is available.
Current AUPRC is custom and tie-sensitive. Standard average precision is a reporting follow-up.

## What the clinician view shows
Decision-support research display
Fitted probability beside its own validation threshold and held-out model evidence
Exact additive feature contributions and explicit imputation
Heuristic day estimate and conditional, illustrative day band
Data-quality ribbon and the reason for any withholding

## Guardrails live
Missing safety information causes abstention
Contraception, thyroid and prolactin flags, age and pregnancy-related states
Early post-menarche, perimenopause and insufficient observed temperature
Withholding removes personal scores, intervals, explanations, sandbox outputs and alerts
The workflow is synthetic and its safety effectiveness has not been clinically evaluated

## The twin and assumption sandbox
Clear boundaries around simulated physiology
Reproductive and metabolic equations generate an illustrative state trajectory
The twin does not affect the logistic score or its reported performance
The sandbox edits invented model inputs. It does not predict a treatment effect
Glucose threshold crossings are simulated counts, not an evaluated glucose forecast

## Where it fails
All declared Kushi scenarios remain visible
Display the fixed scenario seeds with misses, false alarms or withholding unchanged
Different snapshots can fall back to calendar even when sensors are available
A class set containing both outcomes does not identify one result
Robustness, state-estimator and conformal coverage evidence remain separate work

## Validity limits
Synthetic recovery is not prospective evidence in women
Labels and sensor changes share generator assumptions
EHR-lite includes a label-generating internal latent
Old test seeds were reused during development
The current benchmark does not evaluate the complete sequential alert policy

## Reproducible demonstration
Public source, inspectable artifacts and explicit next work
README, model cards and the audit link every claim to evidence
Persisted inference reproduces the benchmark and exposes exact feature calculations
The required video remains a human recording and upload task
Clinical validation, clinician feedback and sim-to-real evaluation remain outstanding

End on limitations. This is a synthetic engineering experiment, not evidence of reliable forecasting in people.

# CycleTwin recording runbook: 20 minutes

Synthetic research prototype. Not for diagnosis, contraception or conception planning.

Human recording and upload are deferred. This file is a script, not a recorded video. Every published number comes from docs/claims.json; read interactive values from the fitted inference UI.

| Recording time | Chapter / focus | On-screen action and narration |
|---|---|---|
| 00:00-01:00 | Purpose | Open Overview, read the synthetic badge and purpose, then enter Meet Kushi. |
| 01:00-02:00 | Meet Kushi | Read the fictional-persona banner and profile. Explain that the story is not performance evidence. |
| 02:00-03:00 | Past history | Show every generated past length, including the outlier outside the fictional usual range. Open the selection-rule expander. |
| 03:00-04:00 | India context | Show the cited population context. Explain that criteria-specific prevalence is not a CycleTwin prediction result. |
| 04:00-05:00 | Static stream | Open Her two data streams. Show demographics and simulator internals. Say oracle-adjacent explicitly. |
| 05:00-06:00 | Temperature stream | Show the temperature prefix and missing nights. Change the snapshot slider without implying measured hormones. |
| 06:00-07:00 | Other wearable streams | Show RHR and HRV offsets, sleep and steps, including their displayed units. |
| 07:00-08:00 | Snapshot day 10 | Open Her twin wakes up. Read the computed probability, validation threshold and any calendar fallback. |
| 08:00-09:00 | Snapshot day 14 | Inspect the current synthetic decision and conditional interval. Read the class set without turning it into a personal guarantee. |
| 09:00-10:00 | Snapshot day 18 | Compare the later snapshot. Keep the retained feature tier visible. |
| 10:00-11:00 | Exact evidence | Show imputed and standardized values and additive logit contributions. Explain that association is not causation. |
| 11:00-12:00 | Feature-tier comparison | Switch the input tier. Identify calendar fallback and the oracle-adjacent EHR tier without choosing a flattering example. |
| 12:00-13:00 | Clinician research view | Open What her doctor sees. Point out probability, uncertainty, data quality and safety status. Read confirmatory-assessment prompts as clinician discussion only. |
| 13:00-14:00 | Contraception guardrail | Open Guardrails live, enable hormonal contraception, and show that all personal forecast outputs disappear. Reset the toggle. |
| 14:00-15:00 | Missingness guardrail | Enable the watch-worn toggle for 8/14 nights. Show withholding and reset it. |
| 15:00-16:00 | Thyroid guardrail | Enable the thyroid flag. Read the exact reason and show that no personal score or evidence leaks. |
| 16:00-17:00 | Scenarios and evidence | Open Where it fails and show every declared scenario unchanged. Open The evidence and distinguish development from frozen evidence. |
| 17:00-18:00 | Limitations: data | Explain that all training inputs and labels are generated. The generator inserts the relationships. EHR-lite contains an internal label-generating latent. |
| 18:00-19:00 | Limitations: evaluation | Explain old-seed reuse, current unmeasured clinical validity, and the status of coverage, robustness and sequential-alert evaluation. Report missing work honestly. |
| 19:00-20:00 | Limitations: use and next steps | State the diagnosis/contraception/conception-planning restriction. Explain that real-world accuracy, hormone inference and treatment benefit are unproven. End on the evidence links. |

Reserve the final 3 minutes for limitations. Do not speed through them.

## Human-only completion

Record a continuous demonstration, confirm its duration meets the official minimum, upload an accessible recording (for example, an unlisted video), provide its URL, and submit the public repository link on Unstop. The session has not recorded, uploaded or submitted anything. Do not invent a URL.
